dataStatement: Real Porto test-split retrieval cases exported offline from a saved TrajAgg checkpoint; these are not synthetic interaction values.
dataOrigin: Source: offline export from the Porto–Hausdorff TrajAgg artifact. The model ranks by Chebyshev embedding distance; Hausdorff remains supervision/evaluation ground truth.

reproduction.artifactStatement: This run uses the official TrajAgg data split, model, loss, selection rule, and evaluation. It only adds persistence of the best model and its test embeddings for the interactive demo.

protocol.statement: Ground-truth matrix lookup and browser rendering are excluded from online retrieval timing.
protocol.learnedMethod: query preprocessing + TrajAgg GPU encoding + exhaustive Chebyshev scan/top-k over saved embeddings
protocol.directBaseline: author traj-dist Hausdorff on WGS84 sequences + NumPy top-k sorting; one CPU process
